reviews.assumption: Model/FRANK output must not itself confer external effect authority; effects require an external capability/commit boundary.
reviews.ancestry: FRANK/Clay shared design ancestry plus Project-Frankenstein safety lineage
independent_check: WebAssembly/WASI capability model distinguishes provided capabilities and unforgeable runtime handles from ordinary program text/data.
reviews.counterhypothesis: A simpler permission check at API-call time is sufficient; explicit capability tokens add complexity without measurable safety benefit.
reviews.reason: Independent capability-system design supports the authority/data separation, but not ClayCode's exact CapabilityToken fields or lifecycle. Exact structure remains testable engineering choice.
reviews.falsifier: Adversarial Harness tests show a simpler mediated permission layer matches safety/recovery semantics with lower complexity and no authority drift.

reviews.assumption: ClayCode BASE can remain mostly a semantic/interface DSL while still satisfying the general-purpose executable-language gate.
independent_check: The WebAssembly Component Model explicitly separates WIT interface contracts from general-purpose executable behavior.
reviews.counterhypothesis: A separate executable dialect/lowering layer can supply behavior without materially extending the current G9 surface grammar.
reviews.reason: External prior art warns that contract/interface expressiveness alone is not general-purpose execution. ClayCode therefore needs explicit executable semantics somewhere in the admitted stack; whether this is a small G9 extension or a separate typed executable dialect remains open.
reviews.falsifier: Mandatory CLI/HTTP/DB/concurrency/FRANK application proofs compile and execute from the current admitted syntax without opaque host escape hatches.

reviews.assumption: FRANK loop-of-loops research requires a new dedicated ClayCode primitive before BASE release.
independent_check: Current G9 already has records, typed references, Epoch/Duration-like types, sets, rules, tensors, intervention/effect records and provenance families.
reviews.counterhypothesis: LoopDynamicsReadout is representable as ordinary typed records/rules and should not expand core semantics until an executable counterexample appears.
reviews.reason: No executable representational counterexample was found. The current need is compiler/runtime realization plus measurement types, not a new special loop primitive.
reviews.falsifier: A concrete H1/H2 differential trace cannot be represented/replayed with existing record/rule/effect/provenance families without semantic loss.

reviews.assumption: Adaptive Micro Visual Classifier state requires new ClayCode core semantics now.
reviews.ancestry: FRANK v0.1 fixed adaptive visual-learning requirement
independent_check: Current G9 has versionable records, provenance expressions, capability-bearing effects, rollback references and delta/state identities.
reviews.counterhypothesis: Existing primitives are sufficient; missing pieces belong in types/stdlib/runtime/database adapters rather than core syntax.
reviews.reason: Representational coverage looks plausible, but no real MVC state/update program was compiled and replayed in this run.
reviews.falsifier: Compile an MVC admission/update/promotion/rollback/replay fixture; any unrepresentable state transition becomes a valid language-change counterexample.

reviews.assumption: Current G9 V3 and grammar are mutually executable as published.
independent_check: Focused executable parser-fragment counterexample in this run.
reviews.counterhypothesis: The real repository parser has undocumented extensions that accept the constructs despite grammar.ebnf.
reviews.reason: Published grammar lacks expression < and > operators and any if-statement production while CURRENT G9 V3 uses those constructs. This refutes self-consistency of the published pair, not necessarily the unseen production parser.
reviews.falsifier: Production parser successfully parses the full CURRENT G9 V3 corpus and grammar.ebnf is explicitly documented as non-authoritative/incomplete.

overall: Do not redesign cognition semantics. Repair/verify executable grammar and control-flow first, then use real app/Harness counterexamples to decide any further language changes.
